notes: Computes trade-log performance metrics including expectancy, payoff ratio, profit factor, drawdown, Sharpe and Sortino.
Contains fail-closed handling for unreliable timing, notional, contract multiplier and PnL currency metadata.
Useful as a reference implementation for validation semantics, not as an automatic dependency admission.
Implements one-sided Student-t significance plus centered bootstrap under H0 with deterministic seed support.
Requires both tests to pass for positive-edge significance.
Known limitation: assumes trade observations are independent and identically distributed; no block bootstrap is implemented, so serially correlated crypto trade outcomes need separate validation.
Uses a single chronological in-sample/out-of-sample holdout with minimum segment sizes and fail-closed timestamp/currency checks.
Upstream explicitly states this is not multi-fold walk-forward validation.
Crypto Autopilot must not replace its existing frozen holdout/governance model with this helper.
Safe-by-default PaperBroker is useful as a design reference.
Short simulation explicitly omits borrow fees, financing interest, funding rates, margin lock, maintenance margin and forced liquidation.
Those omissions are material for USD-M perpetual research, so this broker cannot be used as Crypto Autopilot execution or simulation authority.
The upstream abstract broker interface includes an explicit live-confirmation gate, which is a useful safety pattern.
Live broker/exchange templates and scaffold generation would expand execution surface and are not needed for the statistical-evaluation goal.
No broker API, API key, live runner or order path is authorized by this evaluation.
Potentially useful as a separate user-safety utility, but unrelated to current strategy/data validation integration scope.

overall_decision.recommended_next_step: Build an isolated equivalence/cross-check harness for selected statistical semantics using synthetic and existing non-holdout trade-log fixtures; compare outputs without touching provider, R2, frozen holdout, strategy parameters, model promotion or order execution.
overall_decision.license_note: MIT permits reuse, but any future copied/derived code must retain the applicable copyright and license notice.
